error_handling.rule: When applying the DDM formula P_0 = D_1 / (r - g), first verify r > g; if r ≤ g, the model is invalid and state so instead of computing. Always express the final answer with exactly 2 decimal places.
error_handling.rationale: Prevents a silent division-by-zero or negative-price error when the growth rate meets or exceeds the discount rate, which would otherwise produce an undefined or nonsensical result.
